brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Piemonte association in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus
brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of Piemonte Association in the Treatment of Type II Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: National, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Triple-dummy, Phase III Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Piemonte Association in the Treatment of Type II Diabetes Mellitus
